prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
The Liberal Democrats present themselves as the real alternative: a socially progressive, internationalist party guided by Freedom, Fairness and Trust, with a green thread through every policy. They offer costed, credible plans that shift power from Whitehall to people, defend civil liberties, and make taxation fairer so opportunity and dignity are available to all.

Core funding choices and tax fairness:
- Reprioritise around £5bn a year from lower-priority programmes (abolish ID cards; scrap/streamline DTI subsidies; redirect Child Trust Fund to smaller classes).
- Introduce a 50% rate only on the slice of income above £100,000 to fund three flagship pledges: abolish tuition and top-up fees; provide free long-term personal care; replace Council Tax with a fair Local Income Tax (typical household saving ~£450).

Health and care:
- Free personal care for elderly and disabled people; more doctors, nurses and therapists; end intrusive central targets; faster diagnosis using best-available routes; free eye and dental checks; fairer prescription exemptions; smoke-free enclosed public places; prevention-focused NHS.

Education and skills:
- Abolish tuition fees and restore fair grants; cut infant classes to avg 20 and junior to 25 by reallocating Child Trust Fund; guaranteed subject-specialist teaching; less high-stakes testing, more teacher-led assessment; stronger discipline support; inclusive SEN; vocational-academic diploma pathway; extended schools and 3,500 Children’s Centres.

Crime, justice and liberty:
- Scrap ID cards and use savings for 10,000 extra police plus technology; target traffickers and crime-driven drug use; tough, local payback for non-violent offenders; prisons that educate and train; repeal illiberal control-order regime, prosecute terror in open courts (including interception evidence); create a UK Border Force; fair, faster asylum with right to work; Single Equality Act and hate-crime units.

Economy and business:
- Uphold fiscal rules with NAO scrutiny; simplify taxes and regulation (sunset clauses, single inspections); small-business rate relief; abolish the DTI’s wasteful functions and back skills, science and innovation; raise stamp duty threshold to £150,000; managed economic migration; prepare to join the euro when right, by referendum.

Pensions and family support:
- Citizen’s Pension from 75, linked to earnings, lifting a million off means-testing and ending systemic bias against women; scrap CSA and move enforcement to Inland Revenue; stronger protection for workers’ pensions; higher maternity pay for first six months; Winter Fuel Payment usable for home insulation.

Homes, local power and services:
- Replace Council Tax with Local Income Tax; build 100,000 affordable homes on public land; encourage brownfield reuse; control second homes where markets are distorted; protect post offices; devolve powers, cut ministries and patronage, elect a predominantly elected second chamber, adopt STV and votes at 16; War Powers Act and Civil Service Act.

Europe and the world:
- Never again an illegal war like Iraq; timetable withdrawal as Iraqi capacity grows; reform UN and EU; support the EU constitution by referendum; responsible defence prioritising forces’ welfare and multilateral burden-sharing; tighter arms controls; meet 0.7% aid by 2011, end trade dumping, back fair, sustainable development.

Green leadership:
- Carbon tax to replace the Climate Change Levy; at least 20% renewable electricity by 2020; no new nuclear replacements; road-user charging over time; cleaner vehicles and aviation reform; zero-waste goal with 60% recycling in seven years; sustainable planning; lead global climate negotiations toward contraction and convergence.
